title: Enter NASA's Spacecraft Chamber of Horrors
description: To prepare for Servicing Mission 4, Hubble components must endure harsh tests at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center. This feature explores test facilities at Goddard like: launch phase simulator centrifuge, the acoustic test chamber, electromagnetic interference testing, vibration tables, static load test facility, and the space environment simulator.
keywords: Hubble Space Telescope, HST, SM4, Servicing Mission 4, Spacecraft, Astrophysics, Space Shuttle, Atlantis, Shuttle Bay, Cargo Bay, Carriers, Flight Support System, ORUC, SLIC, MULE, WSIPE, FSIPE, Airlock, WFC3, Batteries, COS, Astronaut, Goddard Space Flight Center, Testing, Engineers, Aerospace, SMC, Universe
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
